rollups.text: Toronto resettlement and career: On 2023-05-20, the user planned to move to Toronto around 2023-07-01, sought a welcoming neighborhood and asked about housing, English requirements, and living costs. The user was taking English classes at a community center, had contact with settlement agencies, and hoped to work in social work while improving English. They were concerned about recognition of international credentials, unfamiliar work culture, competition, and building a professional network; they were considering volunteering for Canadian experience. The records do not confirm that the move occurred.

Data-science learning: On 2023-05-21, the user was considering a Master’s in data science, had completed eight edX courses, and was particularly interested in Andrew Ng’s Coursera Machine Learning course, intending to balance its assignments with personal projects. By 2023-05-24, the user was exploring Coursera courses and specializations in data science, Python, and deep learning, including Johns Hopkins University’s Data Science Specialization and its capstone. On 2023-05-27, the user reported completing 12 Coursera courses, wanted to improve Python data visualization with Matplotlib and Seaborn, and planned to review Python basics and Jupyter Notebooks before starting DataCamp’s visualization course. Course enrollment or completion beyond the stated course counts is not confirmed.
entities: Johns Hopkins University Data Science Specialization

rollups.text: Screen-time and habit tracking: In early January 2023, the user took a 10-day break from social media and afterward became more mindful of screen time, exercised regularly, and read more. On 2023-05-24, the user wanted to track social-media habits and reduce screen time by limiting use to set times. They planned nightly tracking of screen time, exercise, and reading, with a phone reminder, a nightstand sticky note, and weekly accountability with a friend. The user felt good about progress and hoped to maintain momentum; later outcomes are not recorded.

Scavenger Hunt for Artists: By 2023-05-23, the user, who runs Creative Reinvention Studio, was planning a free 2023 scavenger hunt to attract artists and creatives. The messaging evolved from creative confidence and reinvention toward readiness, adaptation, and navigating change and disruption; the user preferred not to use the word “rut.” The user wanted a manageable number of items and asked for a recommendation; the assistant suggested starting with 5–10 items, dividing them into smaller chunks, and giving clear instructions. No final item count or launch is recorded.

Real-estate investing: The user said they entered real-estate investing after a friend suggested using 401(k) money to buy a property. After buying the first property, the user borrowed against its rental equity to buy the second and third. Within three years of starting, the user had acquired 14 doors and a portfolio worth close to $1 million. A mastermind course with Davonne Reaves introduced the user to hotel investing, and the user subsequently invested in a hotel. The user said Nassau Mastermind was expanding their view of hotel and multifamily investing and described real estate as a way to build a family legacy. Exact dates for the investment milestones are not given; the story was discussed on 2023-05-23.

B.O.S.S. Life Design: On 2023-05-23, the user was preparing to launch the B.O.S.S Life Design program and requested promotional copy inviting people to sign up for launch updates. The proposed program was described as a 10-week, community-based self-development course for high-achieving women of color experiencing stress or overwhelm, with work on values, purpose, eight dimensions of wellness, priorities, and a sustainability plan. Proposed materials and support included the B.O.S.S. Book, a guided digital journal, and live community sessions. The records do not confirm that the program launched.

KubitCred product development: On 2023-05-29, the user described KubitCred as a proposed B2B finance product to help business buyers create credit lines and streamline check payments, while helping suppliers manage receivables, get paid sooner, and reduce the burden of extending customer credit. The user then explored a business model, Thai TAM/SAM/SOM research, possible product ideas, a credit-line product vision and components, and a buyer feedback survey. The assistant proposed revenue streams and product features, but these were not confirmed user decisions; no launch or implementation is recorded.

Books and audiobooks the user discussed or listened to: “The Silent Patient” by Alex Michaelides—finished as an audiobook on 2023-05-24 and loved for its retrospectively coherent twist; “Gone Girl” by Gillian Flynn—previously listened to and loved (date not specified); “The Girl on the Train” by Paula Hawkins—previously listened to (date not specified). On 2023-05-24, the user was interested in listening to “Sharp Objects” by Gillian Flynn and asked about its narration, but listening is not confirmed. On 2023-05-26, the user said they would check out Brené Brown’s “The Gifts of Imperfection”; reading it is not confirmed.

Musical-theater interests and plans: On 2023-05-23, the user said they enjoyed musical theater and had recently watched many plays and musicals. The user listened to The Book of Mormon soundtrack during daily commutes, especially liked “I Believe,” and sometimes sang along to “Hasa Diga Eebowai.” The user planned to start with Avenue Q, was considering an improv class or workshop, wanted to learn more about Hadestown and possibly see it live, and planned to check out the original Broadway cast recording of Something Rotten! These plans to attend or listen to additional works are not confirmed as completed.

Trips and travel interests: In May 2023, the user discussed a planned solo trip to Chicago after an earlier five-day solo New York City trip, during which they visited MoMA and the Guggenheim, enjoyed Top of the Rock, and walked along the Hudson River. The user was interested in Chicago’s Art Institute and Lake Michigan shoreline (2023-05-25). The user was also planning another New York City trip and considering Midtown West, The Aliz Hotel, and Greenwich Village (2023-05-30). A possible friends’ trip to Costa Rica or Thailand was being weighed on 2023-05-23; interests included hiking, surfing, local culture, and food, with Arenal as a possible Costa Rica focus and Phuket as a possible Thailand focus. These plans were not confirmed as booked. The user expressed interest in visiting the Grand Canyon (2023-05-23), the Jaffa Flea Market (2023-05-28), and the Swiss Alps, including snowshoeing, dog sledding, and ice climbing (2023-05-29); visits are not confirmed.

Creative arts and making: On 2023-05-24, the user said they had completed a quilt as a birthday gift for their sister; it took around three weeks, and the user was pleased with the result. The user had experience using patterns for quilting but had never sewn a garment and planned a floral summer sundress using Simplicity 8173. On 2023-05-26, the user said they had taken sculpting classes for three months and were comfortable working with ceramic clay. For an upcoming craft fair, the user planned to focus on decorative ceramic pieces, display them on a natural wood-tone table with greenery, add title/price/description cards, and bring business cards and a notebook for contact sign-ups. The fair and dress completion are not confirmed.

Community fundraising and volunteering amounts reported: On 2023-05-21, the user raised $250 at Walk for Cancer. At Bake Sale for Education (reported 2023-05-23), the team raised $1,500 and the user’s individual contribution was $120. At the Food Drive, the group collected $300 in cash, with the user’s individual share unspecified. At the Polar Bear Plunge, the user raised $500 in donations; the cause was not specified. At the Gala for the Homeless, the user spent $500 on a painting and $100 on a ticket and said they did not raise funds. The user said they regularly volunteered at the Animal Shelter but did not think they had raised funds there; volunteer time was not assigned a cash value. The assistant’s $1,170 fundraising total included the $300 group Food Drive amount, so it should not be interpreted as the user’s confirmed personal total.
The user reported completing eight edX courses by 2023-05-21 and 12 Coursera courses by 2023-05-27. These are separate platform-specific counts at different dates, not a single combined course total.

The user’s stated fundraising and spending figures across the events discussed were: $250 raised at Walk for Cancer; $120 personally contributed toward the Bake Sale for Education team’s $1,500; $300 collected by the Food Drive group, personal share unknown; $500 raised at the Polar Bear Plunge, beneficiary unspecified; and $600 spent at the Gala for the Homeless. The assistant reported $1,170 raised by adding the group’s $300 to personal amounts, then reported $1,770 by adding the $600 gala spending; these totals mix individual and group amounts and fundraising with spending.
